acceptedInterpretation: B-a32a strictly implements Wave 1A only: a registered verifier independently derives complete/partial/unsupported coverage basis data; acceptance_basis_generate is the sole verifier-owned signed-receipt writer and acceptance_basis is read-only non-authoritative diagnostics. Wave 1A validates foundational auditable exclusion decisionRefs only; topology-critic identity, role eligibility and exclusion-approval authority remain Wave 2A. PLAN/REVIEW gates, executable evidence enforcement, selective applicability and rollout remain Waves 2 through 4.
